This overview edition presents Jewish Movements: Orthodox, Conservative, Reform within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.

title: Hinduism: Overview — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Hinduism is the world's third-largest religion, a diverse family of Indian traditions without a single founder. The Pew Research Center estimated about 1 billion Hindus in 2010, about 15 percent of the world, concentrated in India and Nepal. This overview edition presents Hinduism: Overview within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
